summary: Enhance your career with our Data Analytics for Insurance and Actuarial Science Course. Learn to leverage data for better decision-making in insurance.
lede: Data analytics for insurance helps actuarial and insurance professionals turn policy and claims data into pricing, reserving, and portfolio risk insights. This course is for actuarial, underwriting, claims, and insurance data professionals who need to support technical decisions. It builds practical skills in preparing insurance data, fitting GLM pricing models, estimating ultimate losses and IBNR from development triangles, and interpreting predictive analytics and portfolio risk results for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This data analytics for insurance and actuarial science training is tailored for professionals who work with insurance data and need to produce credible pricing, reserving, and risk insights that influence technical and strategic decisions.
modules: Insurance Data Foundations and Business Context
Exploratory Analysis and Insurance Data Visualization
Predictive Analytics for Underwriting and Claims
prerequisites: To benefit fully from this data analytics for insurance and actuarial science training, you should have basic proficiency with spreadsheets, comfort with numerical analysis, and foundational familiarity with insurance concepts such as premiums, claims, loss ratios, and reserves. Prior exposure to probability, statistics, or actuarial exams is helpful but not mandatory at the foundation level. You will use Excel and optionally a statistical tool such as R or Python during exercises; introductory guidance and templates will be provided, so no prior coding experience is required. Please bring or have access to a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software and a modern browser to work with datasets, visualization tools, and online notebooks during the course.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
